content.about: Romania is in southeastern Europe, with the Carpathian Mountains curving through its middle. Medieval towns and castles fill Transylvania. The Danube ends in a huge delta on its Black Sea coast. Bran Castle is linked in popular stories to Dracula.

standout.text: Bucharest's Palace of the Parliament is one of the heaviest buildings in the world.

didYouKnow: The Danube Delta is one of Europe's largest wetlands.
Romania has some of Europe's largest areas of untouched forest.
Romanian is a Romance language, related to Italian and French.
